आज सुबह से जो ब्रेकिंग न्यूज़ चल रही है उसके बारे में। एच1 बी वीजा के चलते डेढ़ लाख से ज्यादा आईबीएम ने लोगों को निकालने की तैयारी कर ली है। 3 महीने का नोटिस दिया है। 15 दिन के तीन हफ्ते के अंदर अगर वॉर्स हैज़ अगेन स्टार्टेड बिटवीन भारत एंड अ यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स इस वक्त चल पड़ा है। ट्रंप डायरेक्टली नहीं कर पा रहे हैं तो इनडायरेक्टली बहुत सारी चीजें कर रहे हैं। व्हिच इज अगेन हर्टिंग द इंडियन इंटरेस्ट। मैं तो बोलूंगी आपदा में अवसर है ये। कैसे वो आदि भाई समझाएंगे और भी बहुत सारी डिटेल्स हैं। बैंकिंग कोलैप्स एंड काफी सारे मैटर्स हैं। स्टार्ट करते हैं। आदि भाई अ वेरी वार्म वेलकम ऑन द शो। नमस्कार आपको और आपके दर्शकों को और वापस बुलाने के लिए बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। तो आपने जो तीन इश्यूज दिए हैं तो कौन से कहां से शुरू करें? आईबीएम आईबीएम मैंने आईबीएम का एक टर्म निकाला था। वैसे पहले ही माफी मांग लेता हूं बाकी सब से। ये मेरा पर्सनल टर्म है। आई हैव बीन मिसलेड। ओके। तो हमेशा मैं आईबीएम का ऐसे ही मजाक बनाता था। आई हैव बीन मिसले ऐसा लगता था कि उनको जो भी प्रोजेक्ट दो तो सालों लगाते थे वो और एक को आप ऐड करो उसके 101 ऐड होते थे आईबीएम कंसल्टिंग से फिर अपने देसी लोग तो नंबर वन है तो देसी भाइयों जो भी आप उधर काम कर रहे हैं मैं आपके मेरा पर्सनल मजाक होता था आईबीएम के साथ तो देखिए क्या है कि ये पुराने बिजनेस एच वन बी या कोई भी और वीजा पे होगा दे वर्क ऑन दैट जनरली टेक्निकल कंसल्टिंग पे रहते हैं और मुझे पता नहीं कौन सी डिवीजंस ऑफ हुई है क्योंकि ये सब डेट वो रिलीज़ नहीं किया उन्होंने बट ज्यादातर आईबीएम कंसल्टिंग से है तो आईबीएम कंसल्टिंग में कंसल्टिंग स्टाफ होता है व्हिच वर्क्स ऑन क्लाइंट प्रोजेक्ट्स और क्लाइंट प्रोजेक्ट्स का रेवेन्यूज़ अब खत्म होता जा रहा है जैसे मैंने बहुत सालों पहले बोला था 11 साल पहले बोला था देन द दी एआई विल फर्स्ट ईट द सॉफ्टवेयर डेवलपर जॉब उसके बाद एआई इस गोइंग टू ईट अदर प्रोफेशंस व्हिच कैन बी रेप्लिकेटेड लाइक फॉर एग्जांपल नर्सिंग नर्सिंग में बहुत सारे फंक्शनंस हैं मेडिकल में बहुत सारे फंक्शन रेडियोलॉजी में फंक्शनंस हैं लॉयर्स में है एनीथिंग व्हिच कैन बी रेप्लिकेटेड बाय सॉफ्टवेयर कैन बी रिमूव्ड ईजीली नर्सिंग में कुछ हद तक नहीं बट ऑल द डायग्नोसिस पार्ट ऑफ़ नर्सिंग विल बी गॉन टेकन ओवर बाय द रोबोट्स इवेंचुअली ऑलरेडी वो ट्रायल रंस चल रहे हैं काफी हॉस्पिटल्स में एंड आई थिंक दैट विल बी डन आल्सो। तीन मेन रीज़ है। एक तो क्लाइंट कॉन्ट्रैक्ट सारे फेल हो चुके हैं। दूसरा अब जब पैसा ही नहीं है, डॉलर ही नहीं है, डॉलर वाज़ अ रिजर्व करेंसी एंड पीपल आर नॉट विलिंग टू पे। सेकंड इज़ एआई एंड द थर्ड इज़ उनका जो मेनली द स्किल सेट है, व्हिच इज़ नॉट मे नॉट बी रेलेवेंट टू व्हाट आईबीएम इज़ प्रोजेक्टिंग। बाय द वे आईबीएम के सीईओ इज़ एन इंडियन गाय। तो, यह जो टेंपरेरी लेआउट्स हैं, इज़ गोइंग टू बी एडेड इन इंडिया। तो मेरा आप सब से यही एडवाइस होगा कि आईबीएम अगर आपको आईबीएम में रहना है तो आप आईबीएम इंडिया में अप्लाई करें फॉर ए कंपेरेबल पोजीशन क्योंकि वहां पे पोजीशंस ऐड होने वाली है। आई हैव सीन दैट इन माइक्रोसॉफ्ट केस आई हैव सीन दैट इन ओरेकल केस यहां पे जॉब्स खत्म हो रही है वहां पे ऐड हो रही है। थैंक्स टू ऑल द अमेरिकन प्रोपगेंडा अगेंस्ट एच वन बी। तो यूएस गवर्नमेंट इज़ सेइंग अब हमारे पास पैसा नहीं है। एंड द बिग कंपनीज़ आर सेइंग उनके पास भी इतना लिक्विडिटी नहीं है। पहले क्या होता था? एक छोटे से काम के लिए दे 10 पीपल एंड नाउ दे कांट डू इट। वो बिलिंग वाला मॉडल ही खत्म हो चुका है इस समय। इस समय वैल्यू एडिशन मॉडल। और धीरे-धीरे मोस्ट ऑफ़ द क्लाइंट कंपनीज़ आर आल्सो गोइंग टू यूज़ एआई बेस्ड टूल्स लाइक एआई एजेंट्स व्हिच कैन डू द वर्क ऑफ़ ह्यूमन बीइंग। मतलब एंप्लई कैन बी इज़ली रिप्लेस्ड विथ द एआई टूल्स नाउ। एस्पेशली इन कंसल्टिंग। तो ये जो लोग निकालेंगे उनकी जॉब की जरूरत नहीं है। ये लोग जाएंगे कहां पर? क्योंकि सारे के सारे इंडियन सिटीजंस नहीं है। आई मीन इन सारे के बहुत सारे यूएस सिटीजंस हैं। तो उनके साथ क्या होगा? जो एनआरआई ओआईसीस हैं। ओसीआई नहीं यूएस सिटीजन को कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं होगी इसमें। यूएस सिटीजंस आर डिफरेंट और ये तो उनके लिए है। एच1 इज़ फॉर द पीपल ऑन इंडियन पासपोर्ट ग्रीन कार्ड या फिर अप्लाई किया हुआ है। ग्रीन कार्ड को भी अफेक्ट नहीं होगा। ओनली ऑन द एच वन बी को अफेक्ट होगा एंड दे हैव टू सर्च अ जॉब इमीडिएटली। अभी एच1 रूल्स भी चेंज हो चुके हैं। सो दे आर इललीगल्स ऑन द डे वन। जिस दिन कैंसिल होता है, उस दिन इललीगल हो जाते हैं। इसलिए अभी हमने दिसंबर 31 तक का नोटिस दिया है। आइदर यू सर्च अ जॉब बिफोर दिसंबर 31 और यू लीव। यह है ऑप्शन। कोई और ऑप्शन नहीं है किसी के पास। सो दे हैव टू गो एंड आइदर कोई और कंट्री में भी जा सकते हैं। उसका वीजा है तो आपके पास एंड बट अमेरिका की तरफ से तो आईबीएम यूएस की तरफ से तो आईबीएम यूएस इज़ अ डिफरेंट एंटिटी। आईबीएम इंडिया इज़ अ डिफरेंट एंटिटी। आईबीएम यूरोप इज़ डिफरेंट एंटिटी। ये सब अलग-अलग एंटिटीज़ है। एक आईबीएम अंब्रेला के अंडर ऑल दी डिफरेंट ज्योग्राफिकल यूनिट्स आर देयर। तो किसी भी अदर यूनिट में आप जॉब देख सकते हैं। मेरे हिसाब से तो अगर एआई स्पेस में होंगे तो टॉक टू योर क्लाइंट्स। अगर क्लाइंट्स आपको हायर करते हैं तो देयर इज़ लॉट ऑफ़ अपोरर्चुनिटीज़। एक्चुअली ओपोरर्चुनिटीज़ कम नहीं हुई है। इनफैक्ट जॉब्स इंक्रीस हुई है अमेरिका में। इस समय एक बात बताइए आदि भाई कि वहां पे एक तो इनको तीन महीने का नोटिस दिया गया ना। तीन महीने की सैलरी दी जाएगी। दिसंबर 31 तीन महीने का नहीं है। दिसंबर 31 मींस वन मंथ नहीं नहीं सैलरी इज फॉर 3 मंथ्स नो इफ लेकिन जॉब इज गॉन ऑन दिसंबर 31 वो वो सेवरेंस पे होता है। सो व्हाट अबाउट द लेबर लॉज़ इन यूएस? आप किसी को भी रातोंरात फायर कर सकते हैं। 1.5 लाख लोगों को नोटिस पकड़ा सकते हैं। आई मीन यू कैन जस्ट आस्क देम टू गेट आउट। लेबर लॉस नहीं इंडिया में ऐसा होता तो अब तक हमारी मांगे पूरी करो। पूरा प्रोटेस्ट चालू हो चुका होता। अमेरिका में एट विल एंप्लॉयमेंट होता है। आइदर फ्रॉम द एम्प्लाइज साइड और फ्रॉम द ए्प्लयर साइड एट विल ऐसा ही होना चाहिए। एक्चुअली आइडियली ऐसा ही होना चाहिए। एट विल होना चाहिए कि अगर आपका बिज़नेस कंडीशन चेंज हो रहा है देन यू शुड बी एबल टू लेट एंप्लाइजज़ गो और इंडस्ट्री में इतना कैपेसिटी होना चाहिए टू अब्सॉर्ब इट। अगर स्किल लेवल पर इसलिए मैं आपको बता रहा था ना मोदी जी भी बोल रहे थे स्किल्स आर मोरेंट देन डिग्रीज नाउ डिग्रीज इतनाेंस नहीं है स्किल्स ज्यादाेंट है तो दीज़ आर हाईली स्किल्ड पीपल तो दे कैन ऑलवेज गो टू अदर कंपनीज़ अगर यूएस में मिलता है तो मुझे नहीं लगता इतनी जल्दी मिलेगा बिकॉज़ अभी हॉलिडे सीजन शुरू हो चुका है और लोगों का रिक्रूटमेंट ही नहीं होता इतने इतने शॉर्ट स्पैन में मैं बहुत सारी चीजें बोल नहीं सकता हूं तो यू कैन कंसल्ट बी लेटर ऑन एंड देन आई कैन एडवाइस यू। मतलब ऐसे टाइम पे In today’s episode, we have Karnal Singh, former Director of the Enforcement Directorate (ED), the man behind some of India’s biggest financial crime crackdowns, with over ₹33,000 crores recovered under his leadership. We spoke to him about whether powerful people really get away with anything in this country. And what’s it like to stand your ground when ministers pressure you to bend the rules?

We also talk about ED’s powers, how ED raids actually happen, and whether the agency can summon a common citizen without notice. 

In the last segment, Mr. Singh opens up about the difference between a terrorist interrogation and an ED interrogation, what it feels like to know someone is guilty but let them go due to a lack of evidence, and the truth behind cases like Hasan Ali’s ₹48,000 crore Swiss bank saga. He talks about the toll the job takes, the demoralising comments made by politicians, and the reality of being an honest officer in a corrupt system.

उन्हें लेके आ और आपको ज्यादा से ज्यादा वैल्यू दे पाएं। एंड नंबर थ्री यह एपिसोड किसी एक इंसान के साथ जरूर शेयर करना क्योंकि वन कॉन्वर्सेशन कैन चेंज समवनस लाइफ। आई विल सी यू नेक्स्ट टाइम। अनंटिल देन कीप फिगरिंग आउट। [संगीत] [संगीत]

What does it take to stay one step ahead of an adversary who is constantly trying to anticipate your next move? For Colonel Bharatendu Gandotra, the answer lies in unconventional thinking, sharp situational awareness and the ability to look at a problem from a completely different perspective.

In this compelling episode of Monks & Warriors, Colonel Bharatendu Gandotra takes us through his journey in the Indian Army, from his early years with 24 Rajput to his experiences in Jammu and Kashmir and his transition to Military Intelligence.

Drawing on his military experience, he explores the importance of understanding the adversary, questioning assumptions and thinking beyond conventional approaches. In complex operational environments, predictable responses can have their limitations. The ability to read a situation, anticipate possibilities and think differently can make all the difference.

He also shares insights into the world of military intelligence, where reliable information, critical thinking and coordination between security agencies are essential to sound decision-making. Beyond intelligence and operations, his experiences offer valuable lessons in discipline, adaptability, leadership and professional responsibility.

This is a conversation about the power of the mind in demanding situations, the importance of learning from experience, and why the ability to think differently is often one of a soldier’s greatest strengths.

है। तो जो इंटेलिजेंस ऑपरेटिव्स होते हैं उनको जो गिवन एरिया ऑफ रिस्पांसिबिलिटी है उसमें इस टाइप की जितनी जगह हैं उन सब में इनकॉग्निटो होके घूमना पड़ता है और वहां पे देखना पड़ता है कि ये कारवाई चल रही है कि नहीं चल रही है। है ना वो मतलब पूरा एक तरीका जो काम करने का है वो तो बताना पॉसिबल नहीं है। बट इट इज़ अ टाइम कंज्यूमिंग। मैं मैं समझने की कोशिश कर रहा हूं कि कितना वॉल्यूमस है क्योंकि आपको एरिया दिया गया है वह कौन कहां कितने लोग हैं, क्या कर रहे हैं। उसको ट्रैक करना, मॉनिटर करना, आइडेंटिफाई करना कि कहां से कोई इनफेशन किसको जा सकती है या। हां, नहीं, सी ऑन दी फेस ऑफ़ इट लुक्स इंपॉसिबल। बट ऐसा भी नहीं है। मतलब देयर इज़ अ रीज़न व्हाई एनी इंटेलिजेंस कम्युनिटी इज़ केप्ट लिमिटेड टू अ स्मॉलर नंबर। ठीक है? यू नीड पीपल हु आर इंटेलिजेंट हु कैन यूज़ देयर ब्रेन एंड यूज़ देयर ट्रेनिंग टू बी एबल टू ट्रैक मतलब आप एक पर्टिकुलर जगह में जाते हो दे आर साइंस यू नो वो ट्रेनिंग का हिस्सा होता है व्हिच ऑब्वियसली इज़ आउटसाइड दी ऑफ़ व्हाट वी आर टॉकिंग करेक्ट सर ठीक है ना सो दे आर ट्रेंड दे नो हाउ टू एक्चुअली टारगेट पीपल हाउ टू यू नो गेट दैट इनफार्मेशन आउटर और हाउ टू रीड दी साइंस इन अ गिवन एरिया परफेक्ट सर सर थैंक यू सो मच रियली एंजॉयड आपके साथ इंटरेक्शन सर या सेम है एंड आई एम श्योर द ऑडियंस इस गोइंग टू लव इट सर। बट अभी बाकी है। हां अभी सर खत्म करने से पहले वी हैव अ स्पेशल सेशन ओनली फॉर द मेंबर्स। अभी हम आपसे कुछ सवाल स्पेशली रिलेटेड टू पर्सनालिटी डेवलपमेंट उस टाइप के सवाल पूछेंगे। सो जो सिर्फ हमारे मेंबर्स हैं सर दे विल बी एबल टू सी दैट सर। ओके। सो वि परमिशन सर सर व्हाट सेपरेट एन एवरेज ऑफिसर फ्रॉम एन एक्सेप्शनल ऑफिसर? सर थैंक यू सर एंड अगेन सर थैंक्स फॉर कमिंग अनम एंड वारियर सर माय प्लेजर माय प्लेजर जय हिंद सर जय हिंद सर रियली एंजॉय द इंटरेक्शन सर थैंक यू सेम क्रिप्टो प्रोडक्ट्स एंड एनएफटीस आर अनरेगुलेटेड एंड कैन बी हाईली रिस्की देयर मे बी नो रेगुलेटरी रिकॉर्स फॉर एनी लॉस फ्रॉम सच ट्रांजैक्शन क्रिप्टो उत्पाद और एनएफटीस से संयंत्रित है और इनमें अत्यधिक जोखिम हो सकता है। ऐसे लेनदेन से होने वाले किसी भी नुकसान के लिए कोई नियामकीय उपाय उपलब्ध नहीं हो सकता है।

title: America’s Trade Trap: Why India Got a 25% Tariff While China Got 20% | Explained by Dharmendra Sir
author: GYRUS SULCUS
short_description:
On November 25, 2026, the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) released a proposed tariff list targeting 14 economies under Section 301(b) of the Trade Act of 1974—placing a 25% tariff on India while proposing 20% on China. Even more striking than the numbers is the allegation behind them: "structural excess capacity," effectively framing India's domestic manufacturing push as an unreasonable trade practice.

In this video, we unpack the legal, economic, and geopolitical reality behind the headlines—why India's number appears higher than China's on paper, what the full tariff math actually reveals, and what India's strategic options look like ahead of the January 2027 USTR hearings.

💬 What do you think India should do—sign the bilateral deal to bring tariffs down to 17%, or hold firm on policy autonomy at 25%? Share your reasoning (not just your opinion) in the comments below.

🔔 Subscribe to GYRUS SULCUS for deep-dive explainers on geopolitics, economics, science, and policy—…because I know that I don't know.

#gyrussulcus #dharmendrasir #indiaustrade #section301 #ustariffs  #geoeconomics  #indianeconomy #makeinindia  #tradewar  #internationalrelations  #gyrussulcus  #chinaindia  #globaltrade #worldtradeorganisation
transcript_text: So, America has issued a new decree, and the strange thing is that it says 20% next to China and 25%next to India. Do you know what this is? It's the tax they will impose on goods. Wait a second . Shouldn't this have been the other way around? The country America calls its biggest competitor, the one they say has an ongoing rivalry with America, has 20% tax, and the country for whom they say ' Modi is my friend', okay, the country they call their strategic partner, has 25%tax! How is this backwards, brother? The real shock is not in the difference of these numbers; the real shock is in the allegation that America has leveled against India. The allegation is not that India has committed theft, nor that India has broken any rules. The allegation is: why is India producing so many goods? Why is it setting up so many factories? I mean, what India calls its development, India is saying, brother, if we don't set up factories, how will we move forward? Do you know what America is writing about this in its papers? Unreasonable production houses, unreasonable production. But this picture of 20 and 25 is only half the side of the coin. The full truth will come out later, and after hearing it, your opinion might even change. So don't wander off in the middle, listen carefully. First, let's understand what this weapon is that is being talked about. So, everything we are going to discuss today will center around Section 301. Now, what on earth is this Section 301? See, when we talk about America, America says that it runs entirely on trade, so protecting our trade is protecting our country. So, their Trade Act, which is from 1974 , contains a provision called Section 301. Now, what does Section 301 say? Understand it like a court. In a court, there are three people, right? One who complains, one who investigates, and one who is the judge and delivers the verdict. The three are different, which is why there is justice. Now imagine a court where the same person is sitting on all three chairs. I have come to complain, sir; I have done the investigation, sir; I will deliver the verdict, sir. America's 301 is just like that. Meaning, the very people of America who represent America's trade, the trade representatives of America—they call them the USTR. They brought this complaint. Their own brothers investigated it, and they delivered the verdict too. That is why all trade experts, and all experts in international geopolitics and geoeconomics, use the term that Section 301 is an example of aggressive unilateralism. Meaning, I alone will decide that you are wrong. Now catch a subtle point here, and you will understand the whole game. In this entire Section 301, there is a word: unreasonable. Unreasonable here does not mean illegal. Unreasonable means that even if you haven't broken any law or agreement, you can still face action. This is what they call Article 301, Section 301 of the US Trade Act. America just needs to feel that your policy is treating it unfairly. Now some people might say, "Sir, there is also the WTO. " World Trade Organization. Now, if anyone reads the rules of the World Trade Organization, it clearly says that no country can decide on its own whose fault it was. A committee will be formed there, and then an investigation will take place. But America also knows one thing: the WTO court where appeals are filed, the appellate body, has been stalled since 2019. There are no judges there. If the referee is not on the field, the two players playing have to decide among themselves. Now the question is, why did America bring out this old weapon? The answer to this lies in one of America's own court rulings. So look, you might remember that when Donald Trump became President, he said that our target is MAGA. What is MAGA? Make America Great Again. So everyone said there is no problem with that. Every leader says, " I will make my country powerful." Okay, fair enough. Now America started—in the pursuit of MAGA, what did America start doing? Inside America, Trump says, " Find out where all the goods are coming from." They say, "Sir, aluminum comes to us from India." "A lot of steel comes to us from India. ""Oh, so we are importing it?""Yes."" Then do one thing, put a tax on goods coming into America." And they called this tax 'tariff'. We have talked about this many times: tariff war. How much did they impose? Nowadays, it is being applied up to 50%. "Sir, why are you doing this?""We are doing this so that we have no competitors left." Now, this tariff war that was going on, had taken on a very intense form or a very major shape. You might remember when India started buying oil from Russia. Now, Russia is supplying oil to India. America is telling India, "Brother, the oil you are buying from Russia, the money you are sending to Russia in exchange for that oil is enabling Russia to drag out the war." Otherwise, what should have happened is that the ongoing war in Ukraine should have caused Russia's economy to collapse . India's stance was that, "Look, if I don't buy it, someone else will.""I need oil." "Wherever we get it from, we need cheap oil, so we will buy it." Angered by this, Donald Trump said, "Do one thing: put up big walls in front of whatever goods come from India, whatever goods come towards the USA." Walls of what? Of taxes, which we call tariffs. So, as this tariff war was going on, this game had started in January 2025. You might remember that once, Donald Trump had announced tariffs of up to 26%. Now, two major things happened against this tariff by Donald Trump. First, India stood against it, obviously saying that you are doing something wrong. Second, American businessmen themselves stood against Donald Trump, and some people are saying that in the party's crushing defeat, Donald Trump's party, this tariff war also played a huge role . So why is Trump stirring this up again ? We will tell you the reason for that. Why has Section 301 become so important now? So look, when it comes to imposing taxes in the USA, back in 2025, he was doing just about anything. Then, in February 2026, this year, an India-US deal took place. What was the deal? It was, "Look, let's reach a settlement; you can impose extra taxes on some items." The tax for most goods from India was fixed at 18%. Remember this number, 18, it will be useful later . A full day later, a second meeting took place. The second meeting took place in February 2026, shortly after that. Now, this meeting was not between America and India. So, what was it? The people who were going to impose the taxes were summoned by the US Supreme Court. The US Supreme Court itself summoned them and said that the emergency law, IEEPA—that is a law there —under which you are imposing tax after tax, Donald Trump doesn't even have the power to impose those taxes. Now understand it this way: Donald Trump is the President. He holds the highest executive order. But the order the President issued, he mentioned in it that I am imposing taxes through IEEPA. So the US Supreme Court is saying that according to what is written in the Constitution, you simply don't have the power. So, when Trump didn't have the power to impose taxes, the Trump tariff building collapsed in a single stroke. Now, since this building collapsed, Trump is not one to sit idle. Now what happened is that in July, Trump played a new game again. Now what did he do? In July 2026, Trump's officers brought it to him, saying, "Sir, Section 301 is within your power." Meaning, from that very day, a new tariff began, and under what name did this tariff start? In the name of Section 301. Under Section 301, they said that we can impose taxes on India. That fine, if you won't let us impose it via IEEPA, we will impose it via 301. So , okay, and from that same day, they imposed a 10%basic sanction on everything coming from India, and besides that, they imposed other taxes as well. Now, what is the important thing happening? In November 2026, they have brought a new proposal, and what is this new proposal? That this tax on India should be 25%, or 17%with a deal. Now what is this? Listen carefully now. On one hand, they said it should be 25% , or if you compromise on our terms, it should be 17%. Now, look at these two numbers together. How much was it in February? 18%. Today, if we compromise with them, what are we getting? 17%. Did you get the game? The tariff building that the court had demolished, Mr. Trump is now trying to rebuild to the same height on the foundation of a new law. Say what you will, you have to admire Trump's brain. The foundation has changed, but the blueprint is the same. Now let's come to the word in whose name all this is happening. What is that word ? So look, yes. The word is Structural Excess Capacity. Now, what is this Structural Excess Capacity? So, it needs to be understood . Don't be afraid hearing the name. The matter is very simple. You'll understand it in three lines. First, if any country's factory capacity exceeds the country's needs—the first important thing is that if there is a factory, and the production capacity of what is made there exceeds the country's needs, exceeds the demand. Which demand? Domestic demand. So, the first point is , fine then. What is the second important thing? That surplus, that extra capacity—for instance, if 100 items are needed and 1,000 are being made. Right. Now, if the country is helping in the production of those 900 extra items , then American law says, yes, we will look into this. And the third thing is that the remaining 900, which is called surplus, goes abroad. So they say that at that time, that country enters Structural Excess Capacity, or SEC. So, what is the USA saying now? Understand this carefully. The USA is saying that Section 301 gives the power to impose taxes. When? When a country is in SEC. So, now the USA is saying that India—yes, India —falls under SEC, and there are three conditions to qualify for SEC. First, the total goods being produced must exceed requirements. Second, the country must be helping the factory owners produce those goods. And third, where is that extra produce going? To other countries. Now, listen carefully. Who was this term actually created for? For China. Yes, for China's steel, for China's solar, and this time, America has applied this term to not just one, but 14 countries. Europe got caught up in it, Japan is there, Korea is there, and India is there too. What is the allegation against India? You might be shocked to hear this. So, what is the USA accusing India of? The USA has leveled five major allegations against India. What is the very first allegation being made? In its report, it says that India is creating schemes to support the industry . In their report, they have specifically mentioned that the 'Make in India' scheme, the PLI scheme, the production-linked incentives provided— the very schemes because of which cell phones and solar panels are being manufactured in India—the US is asking why these schemes are even running? And what example did they give? They gave the example of, "Why are you manufacturing solar panels?" As in, why ? The US is saying that India currently has the capacity to manufacture 154 gigawatts worth of solar modules. But India's actual requirement is only 53 gigawatts. So, when 53 gigawatts is your total need , why did you build a capacity of 154 gigawatts? This is what the US is saying. That's the first example. What is the US saying second? Secondly, they are talking about labor protections. This will make you laugh even more. The US is saying that wages in India are not determined by the market. What exactly does that mean? That the market should be allowed to determine wages. Why does the government fix minimum wages? Tell the government to let wages be decided on their own. So, what is the loss here? Because of this, factory owners are getting labor easily, and goods are being produced cheaply. So, the US is essentially saying, leave the laborers to fend for themselves. Then comes the third point: financial repression. Now, what is this financial repression? It is an old term in economics. It means taking money from banks—listen very carefully. Providing money from banks to industries at cheap rates. Meaning, loans should not be cheap. That is what the US is saying. Understand the direct implication: the report says that between 2017 and 2025, India's imports of raw materials and semi-finished goods from China have increased by 97%. It means that the raw or semi-finished goods coming from China have increased by 97%. What does that mean? They are hinting that is it possible that India brings Chinese goods here, finishes them, stamps them as 'Made in India,' and sells them in the US? Now you might ask, surely India must have responded to this. India has responded to them in just one line. So, what is the answer India gave? Now, listen carefully. So, let’s see what India is replying. India is saying, "Brother, we are not doing anything like that." Meaning, an important point emerges here. Look at a difference between the USA and India. India is saying that if you look at my global trade, what India bought and sold to the entire world. When you compare this, we are at -309 billion US dollars. What does minus mean? That India is saying we are buying more, selling less . The US says do one thing, bring a register of only goods from January to December. Goods and services, remove the services , just bring the register of goods. Meaning, how many goods came from the USA to India and how much went from India. So in that, the USA says India is at a profit of 57 billion dollars. Meaning America is deliberately picking the one thing where it can show India is in profit. Whereas if we look at the total goods and services trade, India is facing a deficit in trade with the US. Deficit does not mean that India is suffering a loss. Deficit means less goods are going out and more are coming in. When we include services together. The USA is saying no, no, only count the goods. So because of this, the US feels that taxes should be imposed on India. India says, sir, you are talking nonsense. Now the most important thing, the law these people are talking about—that we say the government cannot support factories, workers shouldn't be cheap, and cheap loans shouldn't be available. Do you know who started this 200 years ago? You will find it strange that in 1791, America had just become independent, you might know. Now America was independent, and at that time America said we have to make our own factories strong. So America brought cheap loans for factories, brought PLI schemes for factories—Production Linked Incentives— that you manufacture goods and we will give you money, and America helped its factories in the form of taxes back then . At that time, what did America call this ? Infant Industry Protection. Infant Industry Protection means America's factories are in their infancy, in the infant phase, so we are helping them. So in the language of economics, this is called "kicking away the ladder." Meaning the ladder I used to climb up— which was the ladder of the government helping factories. Now, as soon as I reached here, the first thing I will do is kick this ladder away. Why? So that India doesn't use this ladder. So India's factories shouldn't grow. We will protect our own factories. For example, even today, 200 years later , America still provides protection to the factories manufacturing chips on its soil. But America has a problem if India is making solar panels at home, America has a problem if India is making chips at home, and America has a problem if India is trying to support its own infant industries. Now, here comes another important point . When you look at who has been taxed how much, well, Vietnam had to be taxed anyway. America has an old grudge. After that, you will see the highest on India . Then after that, you will see it on China. Other countries like the European Union and so on come later. Now, looking at this, there is one more important thing that should not be missed. What is it that should not be missed? It is that the 25%tax imposed on India, listen very carefully. For that 25%, the USA has stated that this 25% will be the one in which the previous 10 %is also included. Meaning, how much was increased? 15%. China's 20%is what is going to give China tension. This is exactly what is turning the tables, which I said in the beginning, listen to the numbers carefully. For China's 20%, the USA has said that it will be added on top of what was already existing. Meaning, ours was 10%, they are increasing it to 25%, which means they are increasing it by 15%. They are increasing China's by 20%. But China's 20%is being applied on top of the old one, so on most Chinese goods , the USA is going to raise taxes up to 40%. Now, the most important thing here is that when we look at this from the perspective of geopolitics, an important term comes up. What is that term, brother? It is "logic of conflict and grammar of trade." I always talk about this. What is the meaning of "logic of conflict"? Edward Luttwak, a geoeconomist, said this. He said that the excuse for war will remain the same, but wars will be fought with tariffs instead of missiles. The battles that used to be fought on the front lines will now be fought through supply chains. Secondly, if you can see here, it is the "weaponization of interdependence." Meaning, one person says, "I have realized that you are dependent on me, so I will now weaponize this dependency ." Weaponize means I will use this like a weapon. So, what is America doing? America is India's largest export market , and whoever has the customer in today's time holds the lever of the machine in their hands. Then at number three, you must be seeing Two-Level Game . What is a Two-Level Game? Robert had a theory that every person who negotiates plays two chess games at once. Meaning, whoever goes to talk on a tariff or any international level, they will play one game with the country in front of them and one at home, with their industry, their farmers, and their citizens. An agreement that passes outside but fails at home will not be considered an agreement. This applies to both countries. Meaning, no matter what America says outside, it will always try to keep those inside happy, and the same happens with India. Then here is Relative Gains. What are Relative Gains? Relative gains say that the real game in tariffs is not about what percentage of tax is imposed. The real game is about the difference between your number and your neighbor's number. An American buyer won't look at how much tax is on India. They will look at whether they are getting an Indian shirt or a Bangladeshi shirt for cheaper. This is called preference margin. That is why I said that Bangladesh will also play an important role in this. Remember one more piece of this whole story. What to remember is that just a few days before this tariff announcement , you might remember that in China, in Shenzhen, America, Russia, and China— what were all three doing? They were sitting together. You might remember November 19, 2026, China's Shenzhen city . America, China, and Russia were all sitting together there. A secret dialogue took place between the three. People say that in that talk, they discussed things related to refined petroleum. They talked about saving the world from the atom bomb, and the third thing they talked about was reforming things related to the UN. Who is talking about reform? Three such countries that are all permanent members, and it is amazing that right after this ends, one of these countries suddenly does something that makes the whole world—what? Starts getting disturbed again. Overall, what do you think about this step taken by Donald Trump? What do you think the results of this action by Donald Trump will be in the future? Do share your opinion in the comments. Stay happy, stay blessed, love you all, namaste.

title: GOVT अब DESPERATE हो गयी है? RBI के Rules रातों रात Change कर दिए | CWSJ-3912 | Sumeet Jain

short_description:
GOVT अब DESPERATE हो गयी है? RBI के Rules रातों रात Change कर दिए | CWSJ-3912 | Sumeet Jain

India’s foreign exchange reserves just plunged by $14.21 billion in a single week to $705.34 billion—erasing more than $80 billion since September’s all-time peak. At the exact same time, the Reserve Bank of India quietly enforced a major overhaul under the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026. While mainstream financial coverage treats the November 20 RBI FAQs and the reserve drawdown as two separate stories, this investigation connects the dots across 53 years of Indian currency history—from Indira Gandhi’s 1973 FERA regime to FEMA 1999, the digital EDPMS tracking system, and the RBI’s stunning September 22 U-turn just eight days before the new rules launched.

In this episode of Coffee With Sumeet Jain, we uncover why the RBI deleted its own January 2026 promise of a 15-month export realization window and replaced it with a strict 9-month deadline for foreign currency and 12 months for Rupee trade. We examine the massive $239.2 billion net-short forward book sitting beneath India’s headline reserve numbers, how commercial Authorised Dealer banks now hold dual power over export credit and the RBI Caution List, and why the November 20 exemption for resident individuals and remittances under ₹10 lakh was designed to quiet small freelancers while keeping pressure on corporate exporters. Finally, we break down S&P Global’s November 23 warning on El Niño inflation (6.1%) and upcoming RBI repo rate hikes—and explain what this means for Indian home loan EMIs, IT and real estate stocks, and NRI dollar conversions.

ईडी पीएमएस का जो एंट्री है उसको ऑडिट करवाना पड़ेगा। कहीं बैंक मैनेजर ने आपको डाल दिया वॉच लिस्ट में आपका गेम ओवर हो जाएगा। अब आपको बैंक मैनेजर को दिवाली हर एक महीने आपको देनी पड़ेगी। तीसरा एक और अगर आप एनआरआई हैं, ग्लोबल इन्वेस्टर हैं जो सोचते हैं कि यार भारत में अभी डॉलर 9293 का है। मैंने आपको पहले बोला था यह आगे जाकर 95 जाएगा। गवर्नमेंट इसे बहुत जल्दी से 90 पे ले आने नहीं देगी क्योंकि उसको सो जाइए। कोई चक्कर नहीं है। लेकिन मैं आपको इसलिए बताता हूं कि आपको अपनी मनी को आपको प्रोटेक्ट करना पड़ेगा। और ये चीजें बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट होती है इस रिसर्च के बिना ये काम नहीं हो सकता। जो मूव्स आ रही है कि हर हफ्ते में या दो हफ्तों में आपको गवर्नमेंट की पॉलिसीज चेंज होती दिखाई देती है। इसका मतलब है गवर्नमेंट डेस्पिरेट हो चुकी है। और जब गवर्नमेंट डेस्पिरेट होती है तो दो चीजें होती है हमेशा ही। या तो गया। दो-तीन हफ्तों में वो मैटर आया तो यूजीसी का मैटर था। लोग भूल गए। दोस्तों आपको सबको मालूम है कि जो ये इलेक्शन चोरी है या वोट चोरी है वो मुद्दा जीरो सब्सटेंस है क्योंकि उसमें कोई भी मुद्दा था नहीं। लेकिन रेजोरशन को लोग भूल गए। अब इकोनॉमिकली हम बहुत वनरेबल हो चुके हैं। गवर्नमेंट डेस्पिरेट है। इतना कुछ करने के बाद भी ऑयल रूपी में खरीदने के बाद इतना बिलियंस ऑफ डॉलर आने के बाद उसके एक्सपोर्ट इनक्रीस होने के बाद तो भी हमारे रिजर्व्स नीचे आते आ रहे हैं। इससे ज्यादा डेस्पिरेट पोजीशन गवर्नमेंट के लिए हो नहीं सकती। इसलिए पॉलिटिक्स हमेशा ही इस तरह से ही खेली जाती है। जबजब आप फंसे होते हैं तो आप कोई डिस्ट्रैक्शन क्रिएट करते हैं। इसके लिए मुझे कोई एस्ट्रोलॉजर बनने की जरूरत नहीं है। सिर्फ फॉलो द मनी कीजिए। आपको हर चीज ऑटोमेटिकली समझ आएगी आगे जाकर क्या होने वाला है। अभी बोल रहा हूं यह डेस्पिरेट पोजीशन है। आप इस डेस्पेरेट पोजीशन में अपना फायदा कैसे निकाल सकते हैं वो मैंने आपको बता दिया। अगर और डिटेल चाहिए होंगे मुझे प्लीज कमेंट्स में डाल देना। और जो आपने लास्ट टाइम मैंने वीडियो बनाया था कि गवर्नमेंट डेस्पिरेट है अभी इनकम टैक्स को लेकर। फाइनेंस मिनिस्ट्री के पसीने निकले हुए हैं। उसके ऊपर आपके जो कमेंट्स थे मैंने सारे कमेंट्स नोट करवा लिए। हमारी पूरी टीम लगी हुई है। उसको कोलेट करने के बाद मैं एक वीडियो बनाऊंगा आपके लिए और गवर्नमेंट के लिए भी कि ये है जो गवर्नमेंट जो लोग इस कंट्री के वो चाहते हैं आपसे ताकि हमारा जो जीना है वो थोड़ा सा इजी हो जाए। उसके वो पूरी वीडियो बनाकर मैं गवर्नमेंट को भेजने वाला हूं आपके बिहाफ पर। इस बार भी अगर आपके कमेंट्स आएंगे मैं कोलेट करने के बाद वो वीडियो बनाकर मैं गवर्नमेंट तक पहुंचाने वाला हूं ताकि आपको लॉन्ग टर्म में फायदा हो। मैंने शुरू में बताया था आपको कि गवर्नमेंट डेस्पिरेट है तो लोग भी डेस्पिरेट है और लोगों ने जब आवाज उठानी शुरू करी कि हम ये फॉर्म्स को हम नहीं भर सकते गवर्नमेंट को पॉलिसी चेंज करनी पड़ी। दिस इज एक्सक्टली व्हाट इस गोइंग टू हैपन
